d: Short, wavy ash-blonde hair with bangs is worn under a black beret, framing a youthful, mature face with golden-yellow eyes. The slender build is dressed in a white sleeveless tunic under a loose, oversized cobalt blue robe with gold accents, paired with wide-legged black trousers and a dark blue neck scarf. Accessories include a gold shoulder pauldron on the left arm, a brown leather crossbody bag, a beaded necklace, and a small red dragon perched on the shoulder.
